equations: fully implicit component mass conservation with Darcy phase fluxes; SCW is an independent mobile phase and CO2-nC10 uses Peng-Robinson phase behavior

units.time: s internally, day in run controls

boundaries: closed no-flow outer boundaries; injector at (0,9,0), producer at (59,9,0)
forcing: CO2 injector at 0.10 pore-volume/year reservoir-total-rate; producer BHP 27.5 MPa

run.disk_limit: CSV summaries and final fields only
run.wall_time_limit: local interactive run; terminate on solver failure

scientific_scope: single-grid, single-timestep-policy comparison; not a grid-convergence or validation claim
